projects.name: WbNews
projects.subtitle: News Genre Classification & Web Scraping
bullets: Built a Python ML system using NLP to classify news articles by genre (politics, sports, entertainment, business) and detect fake news in text-based data.
Applied data preprocessing, TF-IDF, and Word2Vec feature extraction; evaluated and optimized models with GridSearchCV.
Used Support Vector Machine for multi-class genre classification and binary fake news detection, reaching 86% accuracy.
Fetches and bifurcates news articles via web scraping and displays them on the web.

projects.name: CodeNext
projects.subtitle: DSA Next Question Predictor
bullets: Developed a content-based recommendation system predicting similar coding problems on LeetCode data and predicting question difficulty.
Cleaned and processed 1,800+ problems, handling skewed distributions with scaling, multi-hot encoding, categorical encoding, and TF-IDF embeddings.

Trained and optimized Naive Bayes, Random Forest, and XGBoost models for 3-class difficulty classification (Easy/Medium/Hard), improving baseline accuracy from 44% to ~80% with XGBoost and embeddings.
Used Bag-of-Words, CountVectorizer, and Cosine Similarity to suggest similar questions based on text and tags.

projects.name: Recommendo
projects.subtitle: Content-Based Movie Recommendation System
bullets: Built a content-based movie recommendation system using bag-of-words and cosine similarity on title, description, and tagline data.
Achieved strong precision, recall, and RMSE scores on top-5 recommendation metrics.
Built a web application for easy access, generating the top 5 similar movies based on a selected movie.
